title: Excellent Flamenco
text: Excellent! Dancers, singers, and the guitarist delivered everything wonderfully. Unfortunately we cannot film
author: Renan_P

title: Great Flamenco close to the city center
text:
The musicians were incredibly skilled and I enjoyed listening to them as much as watching the dancers. Speaking of, the Flamenco was amazing and the dancers put their all into it. The expressions and movements were precise and beautiful. I would definitely see the show again if I return to Seville. 

The drink prices were reasonable.

I recommend getting their early. We arrived 15 minutes before the show and every good seat was taken. We could still see the dancers just find, but the musicians were out of sight.
author: scott_s

title: Excellent
text: It was more than what I was expecting. It was very well presented. Emotional, intense and surprising in a good way.
author: Alicia_B

title: Great show

title: Flamenco show
